relations.rationale: Ben sorting gloves has no bearing on Dev's shift preference.
Leo not being on Dev's team is unrelated to whether Mina is on Dev's team.
Team assignments between Leo and Dev have no bearing on the group's final agreement about the garden's condition.
Team membership is unrelated to packing up chairs together.
Discussing the layout of raised beds naturally leads into Dev's suggestion about relocating the herb section, a related layout topic.
Discussing bed layout is a separate topic from the watering schedule reminder, with no direct causal link.
Bed layout discussion has no bearing on the weather forecast.
Discussing garden layout is unrelated to Leo's preference for working mornings.
Successfully planning the layout contributes to the overall sense that the garden is in good shape.
Suggesting an herb section rotation is unrelated to the weather forecast.
Arriving last plausibly explains why Gus would apologize for being late.
Arriving last is consistent with and supports the idea that traffic delayed him.
Gus arriving last has no bearing on Leo's preference for mornings.
Gus apologizing for the delay supports the explanation that traffic caused it.
A reminder about the watering schedule is unrelated to the forecast of a dry spell as a factual claim, though thematically connected it doesn't make the forecast more or less likely.
Reminding about scheduling tasks is a routine meeting detail unrelated to the final consensus about the garden's overall condition.
A dry spell forecast could threaten garden health, which would work against the group's positive final assessment.
Leo preferring mornings and Dev preferring evenings are compatible differing preferences, not conflicting facts.
Leo's preference for morning work is unrelated to the group packing chairs together at the end.
Reaching a positive consensus naturally leads into the group packing up together amicably afterward.
